hypothesis_origin.source_system: Palmer Station Adélie breeding-patch concentration result
hypothesis_origin.replication_role: prospectively frozen independent-system replication of the same concentration endpoint; Signy had previously been used for a different breeding-success/lag-2 analysis, but no Signy N_eff value, N_eff slope, concentration null, or concentration decision was inspected before this contract was re-frozen

ecological_question: During long-term Adélie decline, does the breeding population contract non-proportionally among persistent colony components, so that the effective number of breeding patches decreases faster than expected from declining abundance and independent counting error alone?

source.dataset: Population size and breeding success of Adelie penguins on Signy Island from 1978 to 2020
source.support_audit: signy-concentration-support-v2 GitHub Actions artifact from PR 148
source.support_audit_boundary: season/label/numeric-parseability only; breeding-pair magnitudes were not recorded or summarized and no N_eff value, slope, abundance trend, or concentration statistic was computed

pre_effect_correction_history.initial_issue: The first support audit used pandas non-nullness, so string NA/non-numeric fields could be counted as observed.
pre_effect_correction_history.stop_point: The first effect execution terminated while constructing the stable-roster matrix at the first non-numeric field; it did not compute an annual N_eff, an abundance slope, an N_eff slope, a null distribution, or a p-value.
pre_effect_correction_history.correction: The support audit was tightened to numeric parseability and requires every source row contributing to a pooled canonical unit to be numeric; missing constituents are never interpreted as zero.
pre_effect_correction_history.corrected_support_result: Five canonical units remain eligible, with 22 complete seasons; 1997 and 2010 are excluded solely by the corrected outcome-blind support rule.

primary_window.rationale: Signy metadata states standardized CCAMLR methods from 1996 onward.
primary_window.season_exclusion_rule: A season is primary only when every source row contributing to all five frozen canonical units has a numerically parseable TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PAIRS field.

canonicalization.rule: Map literal A1, A60, A1 + A60 and A1+A60 to canonical unit A1+A60 in every season; when multiple source rows map to the canonical unit in a complete primary season, sum their breeding-pair counts.
canonicalization.rationale: The official source later pools A1 and A60; harmonizing the observational unit across time prevents a label-definition change from manufacturing a concentration trend.

primary_roster.selection_rule: Frozen from the corrected outcome-blind support audit: each unit spans both the first and last thirds of 1996-2019 and is numerically complete as a canonical unit in at least 12 seasons.
primary_roster.support_fact: All five canonical units are complete together in the 22 frozen primary seasons.
primary_roster.reason_for_exclusion: They do not satisfy the frozen structural full-window support rule and cannot be added after effect inspection.

decline_eligibility_gate.quantity: OLS slope of the summed breeding-pair count across the five frozen canonical units against the actual centered season values in the 22 frozen primary seasons
decline_eligibility_gate.failure_rule: If the stable-roster total does not decline over the frozen primary seasons, classify the replication question as ecologically inapplicable and do not interpret the concentration endpoint as a decline response.

metric.name: effective_colony_number
metric.formula: N_eff = (sum_j n_j)^2 / sum_j n_j^2 = 1 / sum_j p_j^2
metric.observed_statistic: OLS slope of annual N_eff against the actual centered season values across the 22 frozen primary seasons.

fixed_composition_null.latent_composition: time-invariant pooled canonical-unit shares estimated from cumulative breeding-pair counts over the 22 frozen primary seasons and five frozen units
fixed_composition_null.annual_total: observed stable-roster annual total retained as the latent annual total for each frozen primary season
fixed_composition_null.interpretation: No biological redistribution among the five persistent colony components; apparent N_eff change can arise only from changing total abundance and independent observation error.
fixed_composition_null.comparison: One-sided probability that a fixed-composition/error-only replicate has an N_eff slope <= the observed Signy slope.

primary_decision.support_rule: Decline eligibility gate passes, observed N_eff slope is negative, and one-sided p <= 0.05 under all three frozen error models.
primary_decision.failure_rule: Any failed error-model tail test makes the independent concentration replication unsupported; no alternate roster, season set, metric, CV, or tail may rescue it.

secondary_descriptive_outputs: stable-roster total abundance first/last values and OLS slope
all 22 annual N_eff values for plotting
interpretation_boundary: Support would establish cross-system replication of non-proportional breeding-patch contraction, not individual breeding dispersal.
The five units are published colony labels/canonicalized observational units, not GIS polygons.
Do not claim snow, predation, habitat quality, public information, prospecting or social attraction as the causal mechanism.
Do not use the already-opened Signy breeding-success redistribution result to alter this endpoint, roster or season set.
Do not introduce post-result sensitivities as confirmatory rescue tests.
